categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end metal materials including high-temperature alloys, aluminum-magnesium-titanium light alloys, corrosion-resistant alloys, and intermetallic compounds. Its products serve aerospace, aviation, shipbuilding, nuclear power, gas turbines, petrochemical, and metallurgical industries. The company operates through casting alloy products, deformed alloy products, and new alloy products, with a comprehensive industrial layout across multiple cities in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as precision casting, forging and ring rolling, powder metallurgy, fine manufacturing, additive manufacturing (3D printing), and precision machining of disk and ring parts. It has capabilities in producing nickel-based high-temperature alloys, powder high-temperature alloys, intermetallic forged castings, oxide dispersion strengthened alloys, and foam metals. The company also integrates digital R&D, 3D printing, and metallurgical process innovations to enhance product quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in aerospace and aviation sectors, including strategic suppliers to China Aviation Engine Group. Other major markets include gas turbine manufacturing, petrochemical, metallurgy, power generation, shipbuilding, nuclear power, and glass industries. The company also serves international industrial furnace markets through its subsidiary Qingdao Xinlitong, providing integrated heat-resistant alloy solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a headquarters in Beijing and production bases in seven cities including Hebei, Qingdao, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Liaoning, and others. It serves both domestic and international markets, with overseas sales accounting for over 15% of revenue. The company is expanding its international presence, aiming to increase direct sales in overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the metal materials supply chain, focusing on the production of high-end alloy materials and components. It controls the full production process from alloy melting, casting, forging, powder metallurgy to precision machining, and additive manufacturing. It also engages in upstream alloy material development and downstream precision component manufacturing for high-end equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include becoming a world-class integrated high-tech company for metal new materials and products in high-end equipment manufacturing. R&D focuses on high-temperature alloys, powder metallurgy, 3D printing, intermetallic compounds, and light alloys. The company invests heavily in innovation platforms such as key laboratories and engineering centers, emphasizing digital R&D, material purity control, new high-temperature wear-resistant materials, and additive manufacturing technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of alloy materials and precision components based on customer orders. The company follows an order-driven production model, with sales mainly to large industrial clients in aerospace, energy, petrochemical, and metallurgy sectors. Overseas sales initially include distributor channels but are shifting towards direct sales to improve margins and control.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the most complete and advanced producers of high-end and new high-temperature alloy products in China, holding a leading domestic position in nickel-based high-temperature alloys and light alloys. It is a strategic supplier to major aerospace engine manufacturers and has broken domestic monopolies held by foreign competitors in high-end alloy markets. Competition is increasing as more companies enter the high-temperature alloy industry, but the company leverages its technological leadership and comprehensive production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.52 billion, a 3.4% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 248.7 million, down 22.1% from the previous year. The company has total assets of about RMB 7.59 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.5 billion, showing moderate growth. R&D investment increased by 29.3% to RMB 223 million, representing 8.31% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation despite profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive production capabilities across multiple alloy types and manufacturing technologies, enabling it to supply critical high-performance materials for aerospace and other strategic industries. It offers high-purity, high-quality alloy materials with proprietary technologies that meet stringent aerospace standards, breaking foreign monopolies. Its integrated 'research + market' service model provides customized material selection, rapid response production bases, and full lifecycle technical support, enhancing customer satisfaction and competitive advantage.
